name: Ashok Leyland
step12_scaling_decision: Corporate 5-yr 3-statement model built in full (equity-research Task 2 format: Revenue Model, Income Statement, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, Scenarios incl. rating stress + FY2019-21 tail, DCF Inputs, plus Credit Ratios [formulas] and Debt Breakup). Tasks 1, 3 and 4 scaled to the rating's needs per CLAUDE.md proportionality: credit-focused research note (not a 6-8k-word initiation), DCF + market cushion valuation note for financial flexibility only (no comps/precedents/price target), 8 charts including the plugin's 4 mandatory ones. Task 5 not run (the rationale is the deliverable). Precedent: HLE Glascoat, Happy Forgings.
